design: Three known developmental sources, three fixed-input repetitions each. Exact earlier A2 direct-context requests; no tuning, filtering, additional source selection, or retries. All outputs assessed by current same AI against frozen requirements, ambiguity retained. Not independent expert validation, novel-source evidence, or a method comparison. Keep primary49 unchanged. Stop after nine calls regardless of outcome.
selection: All three existing developmental source cases; not sampled from population. Repetition at temperature0 measures observed recurrence, not independent sample size.
evaluation: explanation_ko only; all frozen required conjuncts, claims assessed 1/0/null. Errors selected for paper only after all nine assessed; first occurrence of each clear error family with full trace. No p-values or confidence intervals.
